import sys
import math
import itertools

MOD = 10**9 + 7
LIMIT = 1 << 20

n = 0
mask_end = 0
final_result = 0
p1_accum = [0] * LIMIT
p2_accum = [0] * LIMIT
flag_grid = [[0] * 11 for _ in range(11)]
a_grid = [[0] * 11 for _ in range(11)]
h_map = [[[0] * 11 for _ in range(11)] for _ in range(11)]

def power_mod(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % MOD
        base = (base * base) % MOD
        exp >>= 1
    return res

def mod_inverse(x):
    return power_mod(x, MOD - 2)

def check_triplet(x, y, z):
    arr = [x, y, z]
    perm = [0, 1, 2]
    for _ in range(6):
        if (flag_grid[arr[perm[0]]][1] and
            flag_grid[arr[perm[1]]][2] and
            flag_grid[arr[perm[2]]][3]):
            return True
        perm = perm[1:] + perm[:1]
    return False

def process_first(P, x, y):
    global p1_accum
    if x == 7 and y == 1:
        state = 0
        for i in range(1, 7):
            for j in range(i + 1, 7):
                for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                    if check_triplet(i, j, k):
                        X = 1
                        while X in (i, j, k):
                            X += 1
                        Y = X + 1
                        while Y in (i, j, k):
                            Y += 1
                        Z = Y + 1
                        while Z in (i, j, k):
                            Z += 1
                        state |= h_map[X][Y][Z]
        p1_accum[state] = (p1_accum[state] + P) % MOD
        return
    flag_grid[x][y] = 1
    if y == 3:
        process_first((P * a_grid[x][y]) % MOD, x + 1, 1)
    else:
        process_first((P * a_grid[x][y]) % MOD, x, y + 1)
    flag_grid[x][y] = 0
    if y == 3:
        process_first((P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y])) % MOD, x + 1, 1)
    else:
        process_first((P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y])) % MOD, x, y + 1)

def process_second(P, x, y):
    global final_result
    if x == 7 and y == 4:
        state = 0
        for i in range(1, 7):
            for j in range(i + 1, 7):
                for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                    if check_triplet(i, j, k):
                        state |= h_map[i][j][k]
        p2_accum[state] = (p2_accum[state] + P) % MOD
        final_result = (final_result + p1_accum[mask_end ^ state] * P) % MOD
        return
    flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 1
    if y == 6:
        process_second((P * a_grid[x][y]) % MOD, x + 1, 4)
    else:
        process_second((P * a_grid[x][y]) % MOD, x, y + 1)
    flag_grid[x][y - 3] = 0
    if y == 6:
        process_second((P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y])) % MOD, x + 1, 4)
    else:
        process_second((P * (MOD + 1 - a_grid[x][y])) % MOD, x, y + 1)

def main():
    global n, final_result, mask_end
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        row = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            a_grid[i][j] = row[j - 1] * mod_inverse(100) % MOD
    for i in range(n + 1, 7):
        a_grid[i][i] = 1
    total = 0
    for i in range(1, 7):
        for j in range(i + 1, 7):
            for k in range(j + 1, 7):
                h_map[i][j][k] = 1 << total
                total += 1
    process_first(1, 1, 1)
    mask_end = (1 << 20) - 1
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(mask_end + 1):
            if (j >> i) & 1:
                p1_accum[j] = (p1_accum[j] + p1_accum[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD
    process_second(1, 1, 4)
    final_result = (MOD + 1 - final_result) % MOD
    print(final_result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
